prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1035; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe during a lane change on a multi-lane road. Insured reports the other vehicle moved into their lane without signaling. Both drivers stopped at the scene. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles received from insured.

Entry 2: Third-party driver's carrier acknowledged liability questions. Insured's statement recorded and consistent with initial report. Witness contact not yet identified. Vehicle inspection scheduled for the damaged rear quarter panel and driver side mirror assembly.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. Representation letter received and all further contact to go through the attorney's office. Claimant reports neck strain following the impact and has sought initial medical evaluation. Medical records request sent to the attorney's office.

Entry 4: Repair estimate received for the third-party vehicle and reviewed. Rental coverage confirmed for claimant pending outcome of liability determination. Police report obtained and notes the other driver was cited for failure to yield during a lane change. Liability assessment being updated.

Entry 5: Attorney's office submitted medical documentation for the neck strain, including treatment notes and a request for a settlement conference. File referred to supervisor for review of liability split and injury evaluation. Next follow-up set for the adjuster's next scheduled review.
